items.q: How does junk removal pricing work?
items.a: By volume. The truck holds up to {maxYards} cubic yards, and you pay for how much of it your stuff fills — a quarter, half, three-quarters or the whole thing. Heavy materials, items with disposal fees and difficult access can change the price. We confirm the final number on-site, before we load anything.

items.q: What size load do I need?
items.a: Rough guide: a few big pieces is a 1/4 load. A one-car garage is often a 1/2. A basement or a remodel's worth of debris is usually 3/4. Whole-house cleanouts and demolition jobs tend to fill the truck. Upload photos when you book and we'll tell you if you're off.
A full truck. Picture a box about 12 feet long, 6½ feet wide and 6 feet tall — or seven to eight heaped pickup-truck beds.
Yes. Couches, sectionals, mattresses, dressers, tables, desks, office furniture — from wherever it is in the building.
Yes — refrigerators, freezers, washers, dryers, stoves, dishwashers, water heaters. Appliances with refrigerant can carry a disposal fee.
Yes. Drywall, lumber, cabinets, flooring, fixtures and general remodel waste. Heavy materials like concrete, brick, tile and shingles are limited by weight and quoted separately.

Yes — light and interior demolition: decks, sheds, hot tubs, kitchens, bathrooms, and interior walls and flooring. We haul the debris away in the same job. Get a quote with photos so we can price the labor.

items.q: Do I need to be home?
items.a: Someone should be there when we arrive so we can confirm what's going and the price before we start. If that's hard to arrange, call us at {phone} and we'll work something out.

items.q: Do you take things out of the house, or just from the curb?
items.a: From wherever it is. Basements, attics, upper floors, backyards. Let us know about stairs and long carries when you book so we bring the right crew.
Hazardous materials — paint and solvents, chemicals, fuel, asbestos, medical waste, and anything else that needs special handling. If you're not sure about something, ask before you book.
When the schedule allows. Booking only shows times that are actually open — if there's a slot today, you'll see it. If not, call {phone} and we'll tell you the soonest we can get there.
Pick what you need gone and roughly how much, add your address and a few photos, choose an open arrival window, and confirm. You'll get a confirmation with links to reschedule or cancel.

items.q: What if I have more junk than I booked for?
items.a: No problem. We'll show you where it lands in the truck and give you the updated price before we load. You can add to the load or keep things back — your call.
Yes. Send a quote request with photos and we'll get back to you with a price. For junk removal, the load-size prices on this site are the estimate, confirmed on-site.
St. Louis City, St. Louis County and St. Charles County. See the service area page for the neighborhoods and towns we cover — if you're just outside, call and ask.
